description: Laboratory experiments are based upon the corresponding theory course EEPC-304. An updated list of experiments is floated by the course coordinator before the beginning of each semester.
outcomes: Understand the operation of various power converters.
Describe the operation of different types of tube light chokes.
Analyse the performance of power electronic converters and drives.
Understand the operation of a solar photovoltaic system.
experiments: Study the performance of unity power factor and low power factor choke based tube-lights.
Study buck, boost and buck-boost choppers.
Simulate the choppers and single-phase inverter in PSIM.
Simulate the choppers and single-phase inverter in MATLAB.
Study the V-I and V-P curves of solar PV modules in different combinations in the field.
Simulate the three-phase inverter in MATLAB.
Study the dark and illuminated current-voltage characteristics of a solar cell.
Simulate the Cuk converter using PSIM.
